objective: Test whether a frozen local representation around the earliest future-changing transition contains out-of-sample information about later branch fate beyond whole-trajectory aggregate baselines.
non_retroactivity: This gate must not be scored on an outcome already inspected while designing the gate. Earlier FIRST_BREAK records remain historical and immutable.

state_contract.input: ordered single-particle trajectory with declared observation channels and provenance
state_contract.latent_warning: observed trajectory is a projection, not full biological state
state_contract.target: later branch fate label supplied only after feature extraction and freeze
state_contract.ambiguity: AMBIGUOUS is a valid state and must not be coerced into a binary class

first_future_break_estimator.principle: estimate the earliest interval where local transition features imply a change in the distribution of declared future fate classes
first_future_break_estimator.restriction: the estimator and thresholds are frozen before outcome labels are opened
first_future_break_estimator.censoring: report an interval when sampling resolution does not support an exact transition time

primary_score.pass_condition: local_ffb advantage is positive under the frozen metric, survives multiplicity handling if applicable, and is absent in mandatory null controls
primary_score.no_magic_threshold: No universal numeric effect-size threshold is claimed before dataset-specific scale and label balance are known; scoring function and decision rule must be frozen after metadata-only inspection and before outcome unblinding.

mandatory_nulls.operation: shuffle increment order within trajectories while preserving permitted aggregate summaries
generate a surrogate preserving declared global aggregates but destroying local branch-order structure
permute future-fate labels at the independent unit level
use a condition or class without committed downstream fate when the dataset supplies a defensible control
mandatory_nulls.expected: no false committed-break signal at the frozen threshold

independence_firewall.unit_of_split: independent biological acquisition or experiment fingerprint whenever available, never neighboring frames from the same trajectory

breakthrough_rule: PASS_METHOD_INFORMATION_GAIN on one dataset is not a scientific breakthrough. Breakthrough remains blocked until independent replication, novelty, material consequence and replayable provenance all independently pass.
safety_scope: Computational analysis of public observational trajectory data only; no pathogen enhancement, wet-lab optimization, gain-of-function design or clinical treatment claims.
